lines.en: I follow the channel back home.
Against the wind, I hug the water.
The swamp reeds are taller than I am.

lines.zh: 沼泽上我一高一低地飞。
lines.en: I dip and rise over the marsh.
The wind shifted. I lean with it.
I drop my flight lower.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，避开苇秆。
lines.en: I skim the water, dodging the reed stems.
I have flown the whole swamp.
At night I know every reed.
Black water below; I do not look.

lines.zh: 沼泽的树太密，我绕着飞。
lines.en: The swamp trees are dense. I fly around them.
The clouds part and light falls on the water.
I must swing around the mangrove roots.
The mangrove roots shift in the mud.

lines.zh: 下面那块空地够歇翅膀。
lines.en: That clearing below is room enough for my wings.

lines.zh: 沼泽的湿气，糊在我翅上。
lines.en: The swamp's damp clings to my wings.
woods has this one perk.
My nest is under the mangrove roots.
I settle on a reed leaf.
Someone is wading in the mud below.
A layer of mist floats over the water.
Sunlight on the mud is very bright.
The swamp flowers open by the water.
At this height, I can daydream.
I'm waiting for a gust.
Distant thunder rolls closer.
I pause on a tip of rope grass.

lines.zh: 泥里冒出气泡，一个接一个。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud, one after another.

lines.zh: 红树林的叶子上，我歇脚。
lines.en: I rest on a mangrove leaf.
Do not wave your hand; my wings are thin.
The name's Littlewood Satyr Butterfly, remember.

lines.zh: 你靴底的红泥，是刚从沼泽来的。
lines.en: The red clay on your soles came fresh from the marsh.
You smell of mangrove mud.
In the swamp, I drift just over the water.

lines.zh: 你踩进沼泽，水花溅到我。
lines.en: You stepped into the swamp and splashed me.

lines.zh: 你的斗篷被苇叶挂住了。
lines.en: Your cloak is caught on a reed.

lines.zh: 泥沼上有你，我早看见了。
lines.en: There you are on the marsh; I saw you ages ago.
That thing in your hand glows.

lines.zh: 红树林的枝，把我的翅尖刮破。
lines.en: A mangrove twig tore my wingtip.
I lift off, then drop again.
Swamp damp weighs on my wings.

lines.zh: 沼泽上的风，把我的鳞吹乱了。
lines.en: The marsh wind has ruffled my scales.
I hide in the reeds and shake my wings.
Scales scatter across the ground.
These wings get heavy by the swamp.
I lost a few scales, but I can still fly.
Half my wing is bent.
I flee deep into the reeds.

lines.zh: 沼泽的湿味里，混着你的汗。
lines.en: Your sweat is mixed into the swamp damp.
The swamp's sweetness, mixed with mud.
That bit of sweetness in the flower lasts me a day.
A little nectar, just a little.

lines.zh: 甜的？沼泽里的甜我认得。
lines.en: Sweet? I know swamp sweet when I smell it.

lines.zh: 亮东西换你手里的甜水。
lines.en: Shiny things for the sweet water you hold.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀，跟不上你的靴子。
lines.en: These wings can't keep up with your boots.
Swamp nectar tastes of mud.
I hover at your fingertip for that sweetness.

lines.zh: 你手心那点甜的，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell that sweetness in your palm.
Next time we meet, I'll buzz first.
I spin once in mid-air.
Your shoulder knocks me apart.
The reeds are too tight to fly through.
Your fingers nearly pinched me.
You have crushed a small flower.

lines.zh: 第二次撞上，我翅都歪了。
lines.en: The second knock left my wing crooked.

lines.zh: 我从你手臂下面钻过去。
lines.en: I slip under your arm.
The tip of my wing bends the wrong way.
My wing is tangled with a reed leaf.
Your wingbeats fall in with mine.
I brought a bug. Take it.
Over the marsh, I circle.

lines.zh: 落到我旁边这片叶子上。
lines.en: Settle on this leaf beside me.

lines.zh: 风正好，一起贴着水面走。
lines.en: The wind is right; let us skim the water together.
I land only beside you.
I've waited a whole season for you.
We circle the mangrove together.
Two butterflies circle above the water.
Your wingtips turn so lightly.

lines.zh: 红树林的湿气，压着我的翅膀。
lines.en: Mangrove damp weighs on my wings.
Carrying it, I fly unsteadily.
I hide it in a crack of bark.

lines.zh: 沼泽的草尖上，我停一停。
lines.en: I pause on a marsh grass tip.
This drop of water is heavier than I am.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，让我翅上沾光。
lines.en: Bright things put a shine on my wings.
I will keep this bright scale safe.
It slips out of my feet.
I grab a reed stem just in time.
Found in the mud; it is mine.
In the swamp reeds, I flicker.

lines.zh: 沼泽的芦苇间，我来回飘。
lines.en: Between swamp reeds I drift.
Wings are fluttering on the water.

lines.zh: 那只小虫落在水面上了。
lines.en: That little bug has landed on the water.

lines.zh: 你站在我巡的这片水边。
lines.en: You stand on the water's edge I patrol.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水汽，把我的翅膀压低了。
lines.en: The swamp damp presses my wings down.

lines.zh: 沼泽的叶子底下，我盯着。
lines.en: Under the swamp leaves, I am watching.
The swamp reeds are taller than I am.
That movement in the reeds is you.

lines.zh: 苇秆晃了一下，我的翅尖先对准你。
lines.en: A reed sways, and my wingtip lines up on you.

lines.zh: 我就在你头顶的叶子上。
lines.en: I am on the leaf above your head.

lines.zh: 泥水溅起来的方向，就是你在跑。
lines.en: The direction of the splashing mud tells me you are running.

lines.zh: 红树根底下，你钻不出去。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots you can't squeeze out.

lines.zh: 沼泽的芦苇挡不住我的眼看你。
lines.en: The reeds don't stop me seeing you.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，绕你一圈。
lines.en: I skim the water and circle you once.
I circle the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 你每踩一脚，水圈就替我指路。
lines.en: Each step you take, the ripples show me the way.

lines.zh: 你拐进沼泽，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: You turn into the swamp, and I turn too.
Your steps churn the shallows.

lines.zh: 我停在你背后的芦苇上。
lines.en: I settle on the reeds behind you.
The small eyes on my wings hold you.
These claws have never been trimmed.

lines.zh: 红树林的影子里，我停着。
lines.en: I rest in the mangrove's shadow.
I said I'd come down.

lines.zh: 红树林里的斑，像小树枝。
lines.en: My spots in the mangrove look like twigs.

lines.zh: 翅上的小圆斑，是给我同类看的。
lines.en: The small rings on my wings are for my kind.
I dive and go for your eye.
I am already at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 这一口只咬到你的衣领。
lines.en: This bite only catches your collar.
One beat and the reeds sway.

lines.zh: 先拍两下翅膀，让湿气散开。
lines.en: Two wingbeats first, to shake off the damp.

lines.zh: 沼泽边新开的花，我看看。
lines.en: New blooms by the swamp — let me look.

lines.zh: 红树林的风，够我起飞了。
lines.en: The mangrove wind is enough to lift me.
The swamp's damp breath hits me first.
They call me Littlewood Satyr Butterfly.
The swamp water glares back at me.

lines.zh: 我从红树的影子里飞出来。
lines.en: I fly out of the mangrove's shadow.
I land on a fresh reed.
One wingbeat and I leave the branch.
Flying at night, no one sees me.
A flame swept across my wing.
I drop into the shallows; my wings are soaked.
My wings are soaked; I float.
The blast slams me into a tree trunk.
My thin wing is nicked, and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 魔法让我翅上的纹路乱了。
lines.en: Magic scrambles the patterns on my wings.
No nectar left, and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 雷把我的翅膀打得发麻。
lines.en: The lightning leaves my wings numb.
No wind, and my wings cannot beat.
